cases.name: Utahnna Dawn "Nana" Bearcomesout
cases.about: Her obituary said: "Ms. BearComesOut was a lifelong resident of the Wind River Indian Reservation. At the time time of her passing she was an executive housekeeper at Holiday Inn Express & Suites in Lander, WY. She attended school at Wyoming Indian Elementary/Jr. High, she graduated high school at Flandreau Indian School in South Dakota. Her family said she enjoyed sewing, drawing, and working at her current job, and being around family, especially her children ... who were her pride and joy."
cases.narrative: He shot her in the head and killed her as they drove to get food in Lander, WY. Their 11-year-old daughter was in the back seat of their pickup at the time.
